caption:
“Just checking in” makes them guess. Tell them what the talk is about in the first sentence.

Save this for your next 1:1.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #difficultconversations

slides.headline: They can’t tell if this is a chat or a <u>problem</u>.
slides.sub: So they sit there guessing. And you still haven’t said it.

slides.label: Say this
slides.quote: “I want to talk about the last three deadlines.”

slides.headline: Clear isn’t <u>cruel</u>.
slides.sub: It means they don’t have to guess why you’re there.

slides.headline: Say it out loud before you say it for real.
slides.sub: Steady lets you practice the hard conversation first.
